subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw core own an opt-in per-agent spend-alert configuration and durable accounting table, or should proactive spend notification be exposed through an extension seam instead?
rationale: This is a new product capability, configuration contract, and persistent state surface; code review cannot determine whether that long-term ownership belongs in lean core or an extension.

options.title: Sponsor bounded core alerts
options.body: Accept the two-setting opt-in core contract after live private-owner delivery proof and explicit acceptance of best-effort at-most-once alerts.

options.title: Move policy to an extension seam
options.body: Keep core focused on generic model-use events or accounting primitives and place notification configuration and delivery policy in a plugin.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded core alerts
recommendation.body: Accept the two-setting opt-in core contract after live private-owner delivery proof and explicit acceptance of best-effort at-most-once alerts.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the feature rationale, production-use evidence, and implementation, so they are the available contact for clarifying the proposed scope; no current-main owner history was available to route more confidently.
